Diagram of a carpel in longitudinal section showing double fertilisation. Show pollen grains on the stigma, one of which has grown a long pollen tube down through the style into the ovary and through the micropyle of an ovule. Inside the tube near its tip: a tube nucleus and two male nuclei. Inside the ovule's embryo sac: the egg cell with two synergids at the micropyle end, two polar nuclei in the centre and three antipodal cells at the far end. Use two dotted arrows: one from a male nucleus to the egg cell and one from the other male nucleus to the polar nuclei.
